rationales.candidate_prior: T receives the finite-comparison simplicity prior; D and P split the persistent prior so persistent external danger is not credited as identity formation.
rationales.precision_scale: Overwhelm sharpens the same normalized configural observation; ordinary evidence remains informative rather than being displaced by an accumulator.
rationales.self_probability: Only P recruits the identity-root observation, while T and D make the same non-self prediction.
rationales.outcome_probability: T predicts transience, D predicts externally accurate danger, and P predicts adverse outcomes especially under low control; all entries remain bounded away from zero.
rationales.localization_probability: Integrated contextual localization favors externally/time-located T or D over identity-level P; collapsed broadcast masks this channel.
rationales.configural_log_coupling: A modest normalized S-by-Y interaction supplies a real observed configural likelihood, strongest for P and never an evidence increment.
rationales.seed_blocks: Fresh deterministic development blocks are disjoint, below 800000, and fixed before schedule runs.
rationales.sequence_length: Twenty-four observed event slices give all three finite candidates repeated normalized predictions without a clock-dependent structure transition.
